description: Building Canada Fund - Public-Private Partnerships Fund is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure. The Public Private Partnerships Fund (P3-Canada) funds projects with capital costs above $100 million. This dataset tracks the approved P3-Canada submissions. P3-Canada is a component of the Building Canada Plan and is cost shared by the province, the federal government and the applicant. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure. Its tags are Economy and Business, Gouvernement, Gouvernement et finances, Government, Government and Finance. The portal shows 2021-01-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
